proof_body:
by
  intro a b hb
  refine ⟨(a / b, a % b), ⟨(Int.mul_ediv_add_emod a b).symm, Int.emod_nonneg a hb, Int.emod_lt_abs a hb⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨q, r⟩ ⟨h, h0, h1⟩
  dsimp only at h h0 h1
  have hr : a % b = r := by
    rw [h, Int.add_comm, Int.add_mul_emod_self_left, ← Int.emod_abs]
    exact Int.emod_eq_of_lt h0 h1
  have hq : a / b = q := by
    have h2 := Int.mul_ediv_add_emod a b
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hb
    linarith
  exact Prod.ext hq.symm hr.symm
